cells.Example: Warm and responsive, they noticed when something was wrong before you said a word.
Let you fail on your own terms, cheered loudest after you'd already picked yourself up.
Rules were firm but explained, punishments matched the offense.
Hovered over every choice, rarely let you cross a room without checking in.
Said yes to avoid a fight, gave you what you wanted rather than what you needed.
Your wins were theirs, your failures felt like theirs too, there was no daylight between you.
Obedience first, questions never, the rules didn't need a reason.
Affection arrived after good grades or good behavior, and dried up without them.
Fed and housed, never comforted, you learned not to bring your problems home.
Meals, clothes, and attention were inconsistent, you filled the gaps yourself early.
Warm and doting one day, cold or explosive the next, you learned to read the room before speaking.
Debts and obligations were the currency, "after everything I've done for you" was a constant refrain.
Criticism and insults were the default tone, praise was rare enough to remember exactly when it happened.
Discipline meant hitting, and it didn't always wait for a reason.
Gaslighting and isolation, your version of events was never the one that counted.
The household ran on a schedule with punishment built into it, missteps were logged, not forgiven.
Raised strictly by a faith or code, deviation was treated as a moral failure.
Money and shelter were never in question, their presence in your life was.
Treated as an equal or a confidant, structure and guidance rarely showed up.
Valued for the labor, coin, or status you brought in more than for who you were.

cells.Description: Pre-awakening. Ren is not perceived, not moved.
Ren can be sensed (Awareness is gained) and can be moved.
A stable, autonomous circulation of Ren is established.
A core solidifies: a stable, condensed center of Ren. Competent. The highest tier most practitioners ever reach.
Multiple cores in an established pattern. Formidable by any ordinary standard.
The mortal limit. Full sets of core patterns. A Galaxy-realm Rennim is a force that reshapes whatever ground they stand on.
Beyond the mortal limit. The Realm of the Spirits. It's theorized that it's only achievable by Yndryr. This is the upper limit of all power in the setting.
Outside and uneffected by all of reality as we know it, only one maintains it (Ylelaim).

cells.Example: Sits on the merchant council, owns three warehouses.
Spends mornings fishing, hasn't worked a trade in years.
Left for a trading run six months ago and never sent word.
Banished from the city after a political falling out, lives across the border or in another city now.
Signed away the family land to a moneylender, or borrowed money from the wrong people - still paying it off.
Spends every coin on drink or drugs, sells off furniture to cover the habit.
Serving a ten-year sentence. What they did might be criminal, or they may just have been in the wrong place at the wrong time.
Talks to people who aren't there, doesn't recognize old friends anymore.
Lost a leg in a mill accident, gets around on a cane now.
Wasting sickness has left them bedridden, healers give it a season.
Hasn't woken since the fever broke from when they got sick, but the body keeps breathing.
